gate_g1.decided_on: 2026-10-10, by the project owner, following the suggestions in section 11
gate_g1.wind_chain: era5_100m_ee, cds_era5_100m, gfs_ee, era5_land_10m_ee. ERA5 at 100 m for history (Earth Engine first, CDS second: same data, the CDS queue is slower); GFS 10 m for the last days; ERA5-Land 10 m as fallback
gate_g1.today_and_history: Near-real-time Sentinel-5P collections for today, offline collections for history and re-runs. schedule.rerun_previous_days raised from 5 to 10 because offline NO2 arrives about 9 days late
gate_g1.so2: Yes: the SO2 detector stays, tested per watch unit (cluster), not per plant. Vindhyachal passes in all four dry-season windows. No SO2 detections are expected in the monsoon
gate_g1.valid_days: Yes: 77 % of Oct–Mar days are valid. No window is widened
gate_g1.flaring_source: firms_persistent (unchanged). No night-time detections near the plants and no annual flare site in the region, so flaring is expected to be empty for Singrauli and has low priority
gate_g1.bbox: Yes: [82.0, 23.6, 83.4, 24.8]; the five largest plants are inside
